value.title: How to Revoke Token Approvals and Permissions

steps.action: On Revoke.cash, enter your wallet address (or ENS name / other alias) in the search bar or connect your wallet
steps.expected: Your address is loaded and you can choose a network

steps.action: Select the network for which you want to revoke approvals
steps.expected: After loading finishes, a list of all the token approvals you have on that network is shown

steps.action: Sort the list, apply filters, or search by the approved spender address. If you suspect a malicious approval, sort by "Newest to Oldest"
steps.expected: The list is reordered or filtered, and with "Newest to Oldest" the most recently signed approvals appear first

steps.action: Find the approval you want to revoke and click the Revoke button
Alternatively, click the pencil icon next to the approved amount to update the approval to a different amount
steps.expected: The approval is updated to the new amount, which lowers your risk while keeping the approval for future use

steps.action: On Etherscan, open the Token Approvals page through the More menu in the top navigation bar

steps.expected: Your address is entered on the Token Approvals page

steps.action: Select the token type (ERC20, ERC721, ERC1155) that you want to check approvals for
steps.expected: After loading, a list of all token approvals for the selected token type is shown

steps.action: Flip the switch for Show all approvals
steps.expected: All of your approvals are shown

steps.action: Find the approval you want to revoke and click the Revoke button
